description: About 32 session hours a week in the school year: one-to-one math and reading sessions, SAT and ACT preparation, and study-skills coaching. About 60% are online video sessions; the rest are in students' homes or a library study room
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Each lost weekday is about $700 of sessions; SAT and ACT students have fixed test dates; families leave after repeated cancellations. RPO set by lesson plans and session notes saved to the email and files suite (SYS-01) and the client-management SaaS (SYS-02)
manual_workaround: Move online sessions to in person or to a phone call with printed worksheets; teach from the paper copy of the lesson plan; reschedule within the same week
dependent_third_parties: Video platform vendor; email and files suite vendor; internet service provider
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner-tutor (single point of failure; no substitute tutor); library study room

description: Booking, rescheduling, and cancellations in the client-management SaaS; reminders; email and text messages with parents about sessions, progress, and safety (pickup and in-home session logistics)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Families must know the same day if a session is cancelled or moved; in-home sessions depend on confirmed times. RPO set by the client-management SaaS vendor's backups
manual_workaround: Call or text parents from the phone using the printed weekly schedule and parent contact sheet; tell families by phone that email is down

business_process: Student practice portal and progress tracking
description: Members-only portal for students in grades 2 to 7: assignments, photos of work, reading-aloud audio clips, messages to the owner. The owner reviews submissions before each session
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: The portal supports homework between sessions; sessions can run without it for a week. Regulatory impact Moderate because the portal holds personal information collected online from children (16 CFR 312.8, 312.10)
manual_workaround: Paper worksheets handed out in sessions; parents email photos of work to the owner (only to the business email)

description: Invoices, package prepayments, and card payments through the client-management SaaS (processor-hosted payment page); monthly export to the accounting SaaS; annual export to the tax preparer
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $3,500 is billed a week, but most families prepay 10-session packages, so a 2-week delay only slows cash flow. RPO set by the client-management SaaS and accounting SaaS vendors' backups
manual_workaround: Track sessions on paper and invoice when restored; families may pay by check
dependent_third_parties: Client-management SaaS vendor; payment processor (through SYS-02); accounting SaaS vendor; tax preparer

description: Intake forms, assessments, progress notes, learning plans, progress reports to parents, and parent-provided report cards, IEP and 504 plans, and evaluations kept in student folders in the email and files suite
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Progress reports are due at the end of each term; IEP and 504 accommodations must be known before sessions. Regulatory impact Severe because a loss or exposure triggers Florida notice for students with evaluations (Fla. Stat. 501.171). The 24-hour RPO is not supported today: ransomware on the laptop would sync encrypted files to cloud storage, and version history lasts only 30 days (P01 R-001)
manual_workaround: Ask parents to resend current IEP and 504 plans and recent report cards; rebuild learning plans from session notes in the client-management SaaS
